title: When a Park Changes Its Lighting
topic: a town replacing some park lights with motion-sensitive lighting to reduce unnecessary energy use
topicJa: 町が不要な電力消費を減らすため公園の一部照明を人感式に替えること
benefit: energy use may fall while paths remain illuminated when people actually need them
benefitJa: 人が必要とするときは道を照らしながら電力使用量を減らせる可能性があること
challenge: residents may disagree about feelings of safety, wildlife disturbance, maintenance costs, and how sensitive the sensors should be
challengeJa: 安全感、野生生物への影響、維持費、センサー感度について住民の意見が分かれる可能性があります

title: Measuring the Value of School Trips
topic: a school comparing different ways to evaluate what students learn from educational trips
topicJa: 学校が校外学習で生徒が何を学ぶか評価する方法を比較すること
benefit: teachers can look beyond enjoyment and identify which activities lead to lasting understanding and curiosity
benefitJa: 教師が楽しさだけでなく、どの活動が長く残る理解や好奇心につながるか確認できること
challenge: tests, reflections, interviews, and observations measure different outcomes and may change how students experience the trip
challengeJa: テスト、振り返り、聞き取り、観察は異なる成果を測り、校外学習そのものの体験を変える可能性があります

title: Who Benefits from a New Bus Route
topic: a city studying whether a proposed bus route would improve access to schools, shops, and medical services
topicJa: 市が新しいバス路線によって学校、商店、医療機関へのアクセスが改善するか調べること
benefit: a carefully designed route could shorten difficult journeys for people who do not drive
benefitJa: 適切に設計された路線なら車を運転しない人の不便な移動を短縮できること
challenge: limited budgets force planners to compare ridership, travel time, fairness between neighborhoods, and connections with existing routes
challengeJa: 限られた予算の中で利用者数、移動時間、地域間の公平性、既存路線との接続を比較する必要があります

title: Keeping Old Trees on a School Site
topic: a school considering how to protect mature trees while renovating outdoor learning spaces
topicJa: 学校が屋外学習スペースを改修しながら成長した樹木を守る方法を検討すること
benefit: older trees provide shade, habitat, and a living connection with the history of the school grounds
benefitJa: 古い木が日陰や生き物の生息場所を提供し、学校敷地の歴史とのつながりにもなること
challenge: roots, falling branches, accessibility, construction needs, and long-term care require evidence rather than assuming every tree can remain unchanged
challengeJa: 根、落枝、バリアフリー、工事、長期管理を考え、すべての木をそのまま残せると決めつけず根拠に基づく判断が必要です
